clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Start against an unnamed or mutable contract.
clauses.binding: Controlling sources: Registry docs 02/03 (frozen oracle), 06 and 11 (conditional successor interpretation, human adoption pending), Architect interpretation of 2026-10-30 section 2, and merged evidence at hub 592d0584. Registry records 12-14 are builder-authored coverage dispositions and are not treated as the governing contract; the tension is disclosed in section 7 and reserved to the Architect.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Design and acceptance are kept apart: Workers B (Q2), C (Q3) and D (adversarial review) each own disjoint read-only analyses; the lead adjudicates. All are the same session lineage; no independence is claimed. No test is run.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Version, authenticate and review governance-critical policy and rule changes; protect established mandatory invariants against configuration override.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Treat unreviewed settings or evaluator changes as governing authority, weaken mandatory checks or introduce an unaccountable decision path.
